title: FossDAO
tagline: FossDAO is a platform that harnesses the power of DAOs to make opensource projects scalable and sustainable
description: FossDAO lets Open source organizations build a very scalable and maintainable ecosystem for their projects. Users are incentivized to make contributions, they are rewarded with tokens for successful contributions. They are also given custom contribution NFTs thereby building a strong contribution profile that they can share.
how_its_made: This project is a dApp with smart contracts deployed on the polygon Mumbai testnet. The webApp is developed using ReactJs. We use skillwallet for identity management on the platform. Covalent is used to get all the NFT information and display it on the dashboards. IPFS and NFT.storage is used to store NFT images and metadata
